create_processor: create a multi-modal processor for a specific model and tokenizer
register_processor: register a multi-modal processor factory to a model class
test_supports_multimodal_inputs: test whether a model config supports multimodal inputs
get_dummy_mm_inputs: get dummy multi-modal inputs for profiling memory usage of a model
build_cache_from_config: build a multi-modal processor cache from vLLM configuration
get_timing_stats: get multi-modal processor timing statistics by request id
summarize_multi_modal_registry: summarize the multi-modal registry that dispatches data processing according to the model
